synopsis: Remove a field from the model draft.
purpose: The `sldb models fields remove` command: Remove a field from the model draft.
how_it_works: Implemented under src/sldb/cli/parsers/ as the argparse subcommand 'remove'. It parses the listed arguments and dispatches to its handler in the sldb CLI runtime over the .sldb store.
